# Security policy

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to the maintainers through the organization's approved security reporting process. If private vulnerability reporting is enabled on this repository, use its Security tab. Do not put credentials, customer data, or exploit details in a public issue.

Maintainers must configure the organization's reporting contact and escalation ownership when transferring the repository. Upstream T3 maintainers do not operate this fork.

See [Desktop deployment and security](../docs/operations/security.md) for the trust boundaries, retained capabilities, and release controls. Reports should identify the CoCo version, platform, affected component, and a minimal reproduction with sensitive values removed.
